body:
**Raivex PvP Pack**

Raivex PvP Pack is a clean and smooth Minecraft PvP texture pack made for fast gameplay and better visibility.
This pack features darker outlines, smooth armor textures, improved weapon colors, and optimized visuals designed for Crystal PvP, Sword PvP, Bedwars, and general competitive gameplay.

_Features
Clean and smooth PvP textures
Dark outlined blocks for better visibility
Improved sword textures
Darker netherite sword
Optimized for fast-paced PvP
Easy-to-see textures during fights
Lightweight and performance friendly
Made for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11_

Whether you're grinding Crystal PvP or playing casual multiplayer, Raivex PvP Pack gives Minecraft a cleaner and more competitive look while keeping the game smooth and readable.

**Created by Raivex.**
